status: BETA — NOT A RELIABLE SOURCE. No official government/BIS chart or OS-shipped keyboard driver for Remington (Gail) could be found and cross-verified this session (unlike InScript, which is backed by the Windows KBDINDEV.DLL driver and the X11 in(deva) driver). Community exam-prep sites (gurukultypingskill.com, easyhindityping.com, typingwale.com) publish charts, but they disagree on details, encode multi-key conjunct sequences that cannot be verified from scraped text without risking silent corruption, and several conflate the legacy Kruti Dev/DevLys font layout with the separate Unicode 'Mangal Remington/GAIL' layout. Per docs/06 rule 1, nothing here is invented: only the digit row (which every source agrees types plain ASCII digits) is populated. Every other key is intentionally left unmapped until a citable, authoritative source is found — see docs/layout-sources.md.
